function.name: tool_a
function.description:
Answer pharmacogenomics questions using PGx pipeline without document retrieval. Runs: Query Rewrite → CPIC API → Final Reasoning. Best for questions that need genotype-specific dosing or CPIC lookup but do not require document/guideline retrieval.

Pipeline | Modules | Cost | Latency | Best Use Case
tool_a (skip_retrieve) | 3 modules | Medium | ~20-40s | CPIC/dosing without retrieval

function.name: tool_b
function.description:
Answer pharmacogenomics questions using direct LLM reasoning without any external data. Runs only Module 4 (Final Reasoning). Best for simple, general questions about pharmacogenomics concepts that don't require specific drug-gene data or guideline references. Use for definitional questions, general explanations, or when the question is about basic pharmacology concepts.

Pipeline | Modules | Cost | Latency | Best Use Case
tool_b (module4_only) | 1 module | Low | ~10-20s | Simple concept questions

function.name: tool_c
function.description:
Answer pharmacogenomics questions using CPIC lookup plus guideline-corpus evidence retrieval. Runs: Query Rewrite → CPIC API → text retrieval over extracted guideline+supplement passages (hybrid search, listwise rerank, top-8 evidence) → Final Reasoning (single pass). Best for questions that need guideline evidence beyond lookup tables but are answerable in a single reasoning pass.

Pipeline | Modules | Cost | Latency | Best Use Case
tool_c (full_rules_top8) | 4 stages | Medium-High | ~60-120s | Guideline-grounded dosing/safety in one pass
